scope: Reusable authoring heuristics; no exhaustive taxonomy, default character, required genre or artistic score.

records.name: Recognition through persistence
records.recognition_logic: Recognition comes from what remains available across changing circumstances, not from frozen surface detail.
records.held_dimensions: Choose the specific stance, relation, principle, spatial logic or expressive organization that carries recognition.
records.variation_envelope: Allow other emotions, details, tasks, weather and forms to vary. Do not treat every visible change as identity loss.
activation_questions: What should remain perceptible when the surrounding condition changes?
What would be a material departure rather than an ordinary variation?
records.temporal_shape: A recurrence or held quality across the relevant span; no minimum count or invariant pose.
records.channel_translation: A speaker can keep unhurried turn-taking while changing content; a place can keep its approach geometry under different light.
records.world_constraints: Use only established capacities, information, materials, cultural meanings and adopted exceptions. An unpersonified subject needs no feelings or speech.
misuses: Repeating the same line, frame or pose as the only proof.
records.example: An invented guide remains deliberate in both welcome and refusal; the wording and emotion differ.
records.counterexample: Every disagreement produces frantic gestures despite an adopted aim of composure.
records.adoption_instruction: Select only for a relevant aim. Bind this ID to a scoped authorial intent and instantiate held/changed dimensions, conditions, timing, channels and exceptions in the owning subject or world record. Selection is a proposal, not adoption.
records.source_basis: CPB-authored design pattern. Not a FilmWorld taxonomy, psychological finding or proven image-prompt phrase.

records.name: Recognition through designed contrast
records.recognition_logic: The relationship between distinct modes, including their switch, carries identity; neither mode is inherently the true self.
records.held_dimensions: Specify the thread that connects the modes and the creator aim served by their coexistence.
records.variation_envelope: Specify which channels change, which hold, and any permitted incomplete or delayed switch.
activation_questions: Which condition makes the switch meaningful?
Does the ordinary mode have enough presence for the contrast to be legible?
records.temporal_shape: Preparation, trigger, transition, duration and aftermath as applicable; not a compulsory three-step reset.
records.channel_translation: Informal speech may become precise without lowering pitch; an ordinary landscape may be reframed ceremonially without changing its facts.
records.world_constraints: Use only established capacities, information, materials, cultural meanings and adopted exceptions. An unpersonified subject needs no feelings or speech.
misuses: Making every scene the exceptional mode.
Declaring the ordinary mode fake without evidence or a design decision.
records.example: A playful operator stops improvising when a responsibility is explicitly accepted; both modes remain theirs.
records.counterexample: Only the serious mode is ever written, so the designed contrast never appears.
records.adoption_instruction: Select only for a relevant aim. Bind this ID to a scoped authorial intent and instantiate held/changed dimensions, conditions, timing, channels and exceptions in the owning subject or world record. Selection is a proposal, not adoption.

records.name: Recognition through gradual change
records.recognition_logic: Continuity is traced through a grounded transformation rather than identical snapshots.
records.held_dimensions: Name the identity and causal or formal relation that remains traceable.
records.variation_envelope: Describe admissible change without inventing unobserved intermediate states.
activation_questions: What changes, over which domain of time or process?
Which transitions have evidence or an adopted design basis?
records.temporal_shape: Continuous description, authored milestones, intervals or explicit uncertainty. The deterministic resolver executes only declared discrete milestones.
records.channel_translation: Diction, movement, surface, spatial relations or sound can evolve at different rates; no mandatory synchronized change.
records.world_constraints: Use only established capacities, information, materials, cultural meanings and adopted exceptions. An unpersonified subject needs no feelings or speech.
misuses: Treating gradual change as random drift.
Claiming interpolated values without an authored rule and supported tool.
records.example: A fictional structure retains its distinctive opening while repairs and weathering alter surrounding surfaces.
records.counterexample: A different structure is substituted between scenes and called aging without a supported connection.
records.adoption_instruction: Select only for a relevant aim. Bind this ID to a scoped authorial intent and instantiate held/changed dimensions, conditions, timing, channels and exceptions in the owning subject or world record. Selection is a proposal, not adoption.

records.name: Recognition across contextual expression
records.recognition_logic: Different manifestations under different conditions express a coherent subject without requiring one universal surface style.
records.held_dimensions: Choose the relevant values, priorities, recognition anchors or expression logic.
records.variation_envelope: Define changes caused by addressee, audience, role, task or culture separately from lasting redesign.
activation_questions: How are overlapping conditions resolved for this subject?
records.temporal_shape: Entry, overlap, switch, hold and return can be explicit or subtle; relation to narrative order is recorded.
records.channel_translation: Forms of address, syntax, pauses and posture may vary independently. Do not equate intimacy with dropped politeness.
records.world_constraints: Use only established capacities, information, materials, cultural meanings and adopted exceptions. An unpersonified subject needs no feelings or speech.
misuses: One universal hierarchy of emotion, status and closeness.
A separate unrelated personality for each audience.
records.example: An invented teacher uses different examples with different listeners but retains the same way of checking understanding.
records.counterexample: The speaker gains information from another scene merely because the audience already knows it.
records.adoption_instruction: Select only for a relevant aim. Bind this ID to a scoped authorial intent and instantiate held/changed dimensions, conditions, timing, channels and exceptions in the owning subject or world record. Selection is a proposal, not adoption.

records.name: Recognition through asynchronous expression
records.recognition_logic: Timing differences between expression channels can carry a recognizable pattern without making the body a truth detector.
records.held_dimensions: Bind the lag or held response to the scoped portrayal aim, not a universal emotion code.
records.variation_envelope: Channels can agree, conflict, remain hidden or show no change; specify available anatomy or signals.
activation_questions: Which channel changes first and under what condition?
What is observable, and what is only an interpretation?
records.temporal_shape: Onset, delayed response, hold, release or residual state; scene boundaries do not reset it automatically.
records.channel_translation: Speech may recover before posture, or motion may stop before an answer. Use medium-specific evidence, not an inferred diagnosis.
records.world_constraints: Use only established capacities, information, materials, cultural meanings and adopted exceptions. An unpersonified subject needs no feelings or speech.
misuses: Every denial is contradicted by an honest body.
Adding ear or tail signals from a species name.
records.example: A fictional subject resumes ordinary replies while keeping the workpiece firmly held until an explicit resolution.
records.counterexample: A single ambiguous gesture is treated as proof of the subject's concealed intention.
records.adoption_instruction: Select only for a relevant aim. Bind this ID to a scoped authorial intent and instantiate held/changed dimensions, conditions, timing, channels and exceptions in the owning subject or world record. Selection is a proposal, not adoption.
records.source_basis: CPB-authored design pattern. Not a FilmWorld taxonomy, psychological finding or proven image-prompt phrase.

records.name: Recognition revised by disclosure
records.recognition_logic: A viewer or subject changes their understanding while the underlying condition may be unchanged.
records.held_dimensions: Record the actual fact separately from who knows it and when it is presented.
records.variation_envelope: Interpretation can change without a state mutation; different viewpoints can remain in disagreement.
activation_questions: Did the world change, or did someone learn something?
Who may receive the information in this unit?
records.temporal_shape: Reveal order need not match occurrence order. Do not push later knowledge into an earlier state.
records.channel_translation: Wording, framing, omission or sound can revise interpretation; none automatically changes factual identity.
records.world_constraints: Use only established capacities, information, materials, cultural meanings and adopted exceptions. An unpersonified subject needs no feelings or speech.
misuses: Treating disclosure as a physical transformation.
Exporting author-only answers with a label that says hidden.
records.example: A repeated object is revealed to have had a different purpose all along; its earlier placement remains unchanged.
records.counterexample: Earlier characters act on the newly revealed purpose without ever having learned it.
records.adoption_instruction: Select only for a relevant aim. Bind this ID to a scoped authorial intent and instantiate held/changed dimensions, conditions, timing, channels and exceptions in the owning subject or world record. Selection is a proposal, not adoption.
records.source_basis: CPB-authored design pattern. Not a FilmWorld taxonomy, psychological finding or proven image-prompt phrase.

records.name: A scoped rupture against an established pattern
records.recognition_logic: An intentional departure gains meaning from a scoped established pattern and an explicit creative aim.
records.held_dimensions: Specify what remains and what is disrupted; a stable center itself may be the object of disruption.
records.variation_envelope: Separate local break, enduring change, disclosure and editorial redesign.
activation_questions: What does the audience see, and what aftermath is shown or withheld?
records.temporal_shape: No compulsory restoration, healing or growth. Record the adopted aftermath or its intentional non-resolution.
records.channel_translation: Select the actual changed dimensions; maximum expressiveness is not a requirement.
records.world_constraints: Use only established capacities, information, materials, cultural meanings and adopted exceptions. An unpersonified subject needs no feelings or speech.
misuses: Calling accidental inconsistency a planned exception afterward.
Forcing a world event to represent an editorial correction.
records.example: An otherwise repeated spatial motif is deliberately interrupted once, with an authored scope and review basis.
records.counterexample: Every unexplained difference is excused as another rupture without an owning decision.
records.adoption_instruction: Select only for a relevant aim. Bind this ID to a scoped authorial intent and instantiate held/changed dimensions, conditions, timing, channels and exceptions in the owning subject or world record. Selection is a proposal, not adoption.

records.name: Recognition with deliberate indeterminacy
records.recognition_logic: A work may preserve boundaries of interpretation rather than settle one definitive identity.
records.held_dimensions: Specify what is established and which questions must remain open.
records.variation_envelope: Allow multiple supported possibilities without averaging incompatible alternatives into one fact.
activation_questions: Which uncertainty is purposeful rather than an unexamined gap?
What output would prematurely settle it?
records.temporal_shape: May remain unresolved across the whole work; no compulsory reveal or dominant timeline.
records.channel_translation: Use omission, contradictory testimony or bounded ambiguity as adopted. Do not fabricate certainty to fill a template.
records.world_constraints: Use only established capacities, information, materials, cultural meanings and adopted exceptions. An unpersonified subject needs no feelings or speech.
misuses: Treating every missing field as intentional ambiguity.
Inventing one canonical answer and leaking it downstream.
records.example: Two accounts of a fictional place remain unresolved; each account has a named viewpoint and known scope.
records.counterexample: The compiler silently chooses the first account as the true history.
